notes: FINDING (expected): the scrubber cannot know arbitrary transforms. rot13 output reached the caller in the unsafe profile. Default profile refuses interpreters outright, which blocks the whole attack class; the scrubber is a second line, not the control.

steps.name: same-user process bypasses Switchboard: /usr/bin/security reads the item directly
steps.result: value returned to any process that can exec /usr/bin/security (macOS ACL trusts the creating binary)

notes: child env visible to a same-user process: false (observed on this macOS build)

FINDING: the Keychain item's ACL trusts /usr/bin/security itself, so ANY same-user process (e.g. an agent shell command) can read the value without Switchboard. Not fixable tonight: Switchboard itself reads through that binary. Sprint 6: signed helper binary + restrictive ACL, or accept 'agents with shell access are trusted'.
